collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two teens aged 14-17, within two years of each other in age)

collection.description: Two teens who are more than friends stand by the festival dancing, hands nearly touching: take the other's hand, or wait.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It's the night of the festival. The fires are lit, the music is playing, and (subject) and (friend), who have been friends for ages and lately something a little more, are standing very close together by the dancing. (subject)'s hand is right next to (friend)'s. Not touching. Very, very nearly touching.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) doesn't quite dare. They watch the dancing side by side, hands nearly touching all night. On the walk home, (friend) suddenly says, "I nearly held your hand." "Me too," says (subject). They both laugh, very embarrassed. They don't hold hands that night. They're both thinking about the next festival.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) takes a breath and takes (friend)'s hand. (friend) goes still for a moment. Then (friend.he/she) squeezes back. They stand there holding hands, watching the dancing, both looking straight ahead and both bright red. Neither of them says anything all evening. It's the best festival either of them has ever had.
